description: Elections Commission - Declare that E. P. Wimalawathi as a member of the Aranayaka Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Aranayaka Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes including the declaration of a newly elected member to fill a vacancy caused by a member ceasing to belong to their political party. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it deals with electoral matters, candidate nominations, and declarations of elected members for local authorities.
